name: Rahab
title: The Prostitute Who Believed
summary: Rahab was a prostitute in Jericho who hid the Israelite spies and helped them escape. She confessed faith in the God of Israel and asked for protection for her family. She was spared when Jericho fell, was incorporated into Israel, and became an ancestor in the lineage of the Messiah through her son Boaz.

keyEvents.title: Hid the Spies
keyEvents.description: When Joshua sent two spies to Jericho, Rahab welcomed them and hid them on the roof under stalks of flax.

keyEvents.title: The Confession of Faith
keyEvents.description: Rahab confessed that the God of Israel is God in heaven above and on earth below, and that fear of Israel had seized the people of Jericho.

keyEvents.title: The Covenant of Deliverance
keyEvents.description: Rahab asked the spies to swear that her family would be spared. They gave her a scarlet cord as a sign.

keyEvents.title: Saved from Destruction
keyEvents.description: When Jericho fell, Rahab and her family were saved because she had hung out the scarlet cord.

keyEvents.title: In the Messiah's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Rahab married Salmon and became the mother of Boaz—and thus an ancestor in Jesus' lineage.
